column3: “The body of Jesus” makes explicit the object expressed as “Him”.
BSB, like the Textus Receptus, lacks the shorter ending (“they promptly reported…”, συντόμως) that the critical text prints in double brackets.
Verses 9–20 (the longer ending) are printed in double brackets in the critical text; BSB includes them, as does the Textus Receptus.
“Went back” adds the direction of return to “went”.
BSB’s “with their hands” follows the critical text (χερσὶν); the Textus Receptus lacks it.
“Worked through them” replaces “worked with them”; “His” is added to “word”.
